description: Xingtai 380 V high-flow hydraulic concrete spraying machine lists dual copper motors 11/15 kW, 7 m³/h, 8 MPa, 150 m / 70 m and particle ≤8 mm for cement mortar, concrete or grout. faqs.question: Is the 7 m³/h unit a substitute for the compact 5 m³/h sprayer on constrained floors?
faqs.answer: No. The compact hydraulic sprayer lists 295 kg and 1500 × 700 × 1100 mm. This high-flow row lists 650 kg and 2500 × 1000 × 1100 mm.

faqs.question: Is M9 the same as this high-flow sprayer?
faqs.answer: No. M9 is plaster at 30 L/min, 50 bar, 25 mm hose, particle ≤4 mm and 200 kg.
